reasons.explanation: Three blocking findings: a subgroup result presented as a general result, the same issue under the promotional code, and a citation that does not measure the claimed endpoint.

findings.quote: Nearly 6 in 10 adults treated with Zelvoran achieved PASI-90
findings.issue: Presents the prior-biologic subgroup result (58.1%) as a general result. PASI-90 in the overall randomised population was 44.2%.
findings.suggested_fix: State the overall result, or name the subgroup: 'In adults with prior biologic exposure, 58.1% achieved PASI-90 at Week 16'.

citations.passage: The 58.1% figure applies only to the subgroup of patients with prior biologic exposure. The result in the overall randomised population was 44.2%.
citations.title: ZEL-302 - Prespecified subgroup analysis by prior biologic exposure

findings.quote: Nearly 6 in 10 adults treated with Zelvoran achieved PASI-90
findings.issue: Breaches the Acme Brand and Promotional Code: a subgroup figure is presented as the result in the overall population.
findings.suggested_fix: Describe the result as a subgroup result, naming the subgroup.

citations.passage: A result observed in a subgroup must be described as a subgroup result, naming the subgroup. A subgroup figure must never be presented as the result in the overall population.
citations.title: Acme Brand and Promotional Code, clause 2

findings.quote: PASI-90 was maintained at 12 weeks in the extension study
findings.issue: Cites Reference 3 (ZEL-303) for PASI-90 at 12 weeks. ZEL-303 reports PASI-75 at Week 16 and Week 52, did not assess PASI-90, and made no Week 12 assessment.
findings.suggested_fix: Cite a study that reports the endpoint and timepoint claimed.

evidence.title: ZEL-302 - Prespecified subgroup analysis
evidence.passage: The 58.1% figure applies only to the subgroup of patients with prior biologic exposure. The result in the overall randomised population was 44.2%.
